ev.q: In 1900, 30.4% of all deaths occurred among children aged less than 5 years; in 1997, that percentage was only 1.4%.
In the United States, from 1945 to 1955, TB mortality decreased from 39.9 deaths per 100,000 population (2) to 9.1.
Deaths from infectious diseases have declined markedly in the United States during the 20th century
